title: Google DeepMind launches AlphaGenome 2, trained on 100M+ cell profiles across 68 tissues to predict the effects of genetic variants, for non-commercial research (Robert Hart/The Verge)
summary: Robert Hart / The Verge: Google DeepMind launches AlphaGenome 2, trained on 100M+ cell profiles across 68 tissues to predict the effects of genetic variants, for non-commercial research — DeepMind's new DNA model better predicts how mutations affect different cells, potentially opening paths to treatment.
